headline: Day 1 is fixed. Two workforces aren’t one yet.
trigger: Deal closed, often a PE-backed add-on, and an integration lead is named.
pains: The deal timeline leaves no room for a slow business case
Finance, legal, and IT have integration owners. Employees don’t.
Anxious employees fill communication gaps with rumor
Acquired-company managers aren’t equipped to lead the change
message: Integration plans cover systems and contracts. Synergies depend on whether two workforces actually work as one.
cta: OCM Leadership to Day 1 and Day 100
